rules.message: No AI attribution in commits or PRs: drop the Co-Authored-By, "Generated with Claude Code" and session-link lines.
Make the branch with `git branch <name> <start>` and then `git checkout <name>`: checkout -b with a start point once set an upstream that pushed to development.
Name the owner explicitly: gh repo create <owner>/<repo>. gh's default account may not be the one you want.
